label: project-discovery-v1
implementation: createResolver.discover with allowConfigExecution; every request independently probes browser and Node; no policies injected by the audit
supplementalScope: Nine explicit Node builtin checks and twelve original-source Node lookups for Rollup-externalized requests. These do not alter the primary comparison or establish automatic layer assignment/build equivalence.
requestContext: Discovery probes browser and Node independently; development for Vite/Next projects and production for Node/Rollup, with import/require selected per request. Primary native comparisons retain browser for Vite/Next and Node for Node/Rollup; this reference choice does not assign source layers.
identityComparison: Raw identities retained; file URLs normalized to filesystem paths with query/fragment for comparison. Matching unresolved outcomes are not passes.
